content:
olivia_sales: ACME procurement raised a blocker: they need a concise EU-only data flow diagram, an up-to-date subprocessor roster that indicates which processors touch PII, and confirmation that backups and logs containing PII stay in EU. They want this pack for their vendor risk team by tomorrow AM.

mike_presales: I can produce a 1-page DFD PNG, a CSV with columns (processor, role, data_classes, region, eu_residency_flag), and a short blurb for SIG/CAIQ fields. Quick question: do they accept Dedicated with region pinning or insist on Private?

olivia_sales: Their security lead prefers no multi-region fallbacks for PII; Dedicated pinned to EU is acceptable. Hosted is only ok if we can guarantee no cross-border backups and a no-fallback routing policy.

mike_presales: Noted. Draft snippet for Hosted pinning to include in the pack:
```yaml
routing:
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: false
storage:
  backups_enabled: false
  backup_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent: false
```

jess_security: Add technical caveat: ephemeral KV cache for Hosted, persistent Redis only for Dedicated/Private in EU. Metrics must be pseudonymized before export and stored in EU buckets. KMS: recommend customer-managed keys in EU; Redwood supports HSM-backed keys if customer agrees to split-escrow terms.

mike_presales: Quick paste for CAIQ/network segmentation Q: "Redwood applies tenant-level isolation across all deployment modes. Data in transit is protected with TLS1.2+; at-rest encryption is AES-256. For Dedicated and Private we use VPC-level segmentation; for Hosted we enforce strict routing policies and provide VPC peering options. Customer-managed KMS is supported for key sovereignty."

anna_legal: When you post subprocessors include a notification clause example: "Redwood will notify Customer 30 days prior to onboarding any subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may object and require mitigation or termination of that subprocessor." I'll prepare DPA language if they request changes.

mike_presales: I'll assemble and upload the DFD + CSV + CAIQ blurb by EOD and add a short pricing note comparing Hosted (EU-pin) vs Dedicated vs Private for their estimated 50 RPS.

olivia_sales: Thanks — once uploaded I'll forward to ACME-security and loop legal if they ask for evidence packages.
